builds.name: Heroic Swing: counted-shot AD and attack-speed test
builds.summary: Investigate high Heroic Swing shots in one three-second observation output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high Heroic Swing shots in one three-second observation output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The per-shot helper is (8/16/24/32/40 + 0.25 total AD) times (1 + 0.3 times the bonus-attack-speed stat term). Bonus attack speed therefore has potential beyond ordinary attack frequency, but its stat normalization and the number of legal shots must be observed. Collision and release can end the swing. A separate critical helper scales the core by 1 + 0.5 times (critical-damage stat minus 1); this is a special critical rule, not automatic ordinary-attack crit inheritance.
